セマンティックモデルから Ontology を生成すること、セマンティックモデル: Generating an ontology from a semantic model, grounding an answer in one, and binding data to an ontology are three different operations
セマンティックモデルをめぐっては、3 つの別々の操作が混同されがちです。1 つ目: Three separate operations are easily conflated around a semantic model. The first is generating an ontology from a semantic model. The second is grounding an answer in one. The third is binding data to an ontology entity. For generation, the supported modes and prerequisites are set out in the published documentation (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/iq/ontology/concepts-generate). Separately, how a Data Agent routes to a source is a contract configured on the Data Agent, and changing the ontology definition does not change it automatically.
生成・グラウンディング・バインディングは別: Generating, grounding and binding are different
処理される地域は容量のリージョンで決まる。リージョン外処理を許可する Copil: The region where processing happens follows the capacity's region. Enabling the Copilot tenant setting that permits processing outside the capacity region allows processing beyond it. For the exact current name of that setting, see the Copilot tenant settings entry in appendix E.
Entity Type の名前とカスタム Property の名前には、同じ公式: Entity type names and custom property names follow the same official rule: 1 to 26 characters, alphanumerics, hyphens and underscores only, beginning and ending with an alphanumeric character. The rule is stated in both the create-entity-types and the data-binding how-to (see Create entity types and Bind data in appendix E). In this workshop the entity type `MunicipalityCategoryMetric` and the properties `MunicipalityPrefAmountRank` and `MunicipalityStaticTotalYen` are all 26 characters, exactly at the currently published limit. Entering the tables as printed is fine, but when you think of a change that lengthens a name, those three break the rule first.
Entity Type と Property の名前は 1〜26 文字: Entity type and property names are 1 to 26 characters
名前の規則は、Entity Type の名前とカスタム Property の名前: The naming rule applies to entity type names and to custom property names alike: 1 to 26 characters, alphanumerics, hyphens and underscores only, beginning and ending with an alphanumeric character (see Create entity types and Bind data in appendix E). In this workshop the entity type `MunicipalityCategoryMetric` and the properties `MunicipalityPrefAmountRank` and `MunicipalityStaticTotalYen` are all 26 characters, exactly at the currently published limit. When a change that lengthens names is proposed, check those three first.
